Album Cover Tunnel preview for the guitar workbench

Official component: https://leibox.pantoria.cn/docs/animations/album-cover-tunnel
Source package: https://leibox.pantoria.cn/ai/packages/album-cover-tunnel/vanilla.json
Component author: LeiShiFu; upstream license: LEIBOX-LICENSE.md.
Three.js 0.185.1: see three/LICENSE.

Original source checksums are verified by scripts/fetch-tunnel.mjs.
Local adaptations: remove unused embedded demonstration covers; add the .js
extension to the runtime import; strip TypeScript types for browser execution.
The application supplies its existing song artwork. Artwork rights remain
with their respective rights holders.

This is an isolated application preview, not a standalone component library.
No tunnel code is loaded by the normal workbench homepage or score reader.

Liquid Glass Navigation:
https://leibox.pantoria.cn/docs/animations/liquid-glass-navigation
https://leibox.pantoria.cn/ai/packages/liquid-glass-navigation/vanilla.json
Adaptation by scripts/fetch-glass-navigation.mjs (verified original SHA256):
retains the official Snell/dispersion optical shader and spring navigation;
removes demo photograph/font; samples an aligned crop of the actual tunnel canvas;
draws transparent outside the panel; renders on demand instead of perpetually.
Menu labels and callbacks connect to existing workbench actions.
The supplied upstream source attribution comments are retained.

2026-11-26 revision: rebuilt from the user's supplied complete React code package
(optical engine is framework-independent). source-receipt.json records original
file SHA256 values. Retains Snell 1.52, five-band dispersion, squircle normals,
38px optical bevel and spring state machine. Screen-aligned UVs replace the
independent garden camera. Removes preblur/double darkening; adjusts absorption
for the existing dark tunnel. Live crop sampling is bounded to 15Hz while a menu
is open, with one reused canvas; stops when closed/hidden and disposes on exit.
